capabilities: Show a base's views as tabs with view type icons
Set per-tab color, size and visibility
Switch to next or previous view by command
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.14.0 or later. Tabs are not shown for bases embedded in notes or code blocks. The plugin relies on Obsidian internals for the Bases toolbar and view list, so a future Obsidian update may stop the tabs from showing; tab settings are stored in the .base file.
intentEvidence: switch views with one click instead of opening the view menu
problem: A base's views are only reachable through the view menu, so there is no at-a-glance list for switching between them.
summary: Adds a tab bar to Obsidian bases so each view can be opened with one click, with per-tab color, size and visibility settings.
